user_saw: A session could keep showing as busy after a Gateway-started run finished, until another message arrived.
summary: The fix emits a runtime settlement event when a Gateway-started backend run releases session ownership, so subscribers receive an updated activity state.
reasoning: The session-controller refactor added an ownership release path that updates internal state without publishing a settlement event. I checked the preceding Gateway publisher and activity projection, which could also count an unfinished reply operation in a terminal snapshot, so the available history does not establish when autonomous runs first began leaving subscribers with stale busy state.
